div.div:
FastMCP Python Example:
@mcp.tool()
async def create_beam(params: BeamParams) -> str:
# Pydantic automatically validates:
# - start_x, start_y, start_z are numbers
# - profile is string
# - material is string
payload = {
"start_point": {"x": params.start_x, "y": params.start_y, "z": params.start_z},
"end_point": {"x": params.end_x, "y": params.end_y, "z": params.end_z},
"profile": params.profile,
"material": params.material
}
return await make_http_request("/create-beam-advanced", payload)

div.div:
What happens in Tekla:
1. Profile Lookup: Tekla searches catalog for "W12X50" profile
2. Material Lookup: Tekla validates "A992" material exists
3. Geometry Creation: Creates beam from (0,0,0) to (0,0,10000mm)
4. Database Insert: Adds beam to 3D model database
5. ID Assignment: Tekla assigns unique ID (e.g., 12345)
6. Model Update: 3D view refreshes showing new column
